definitions.explanation: Cleverly deceptive or dishonest in achieving one's aims.
Not following the rules or playing fairly.

examples.japanese: ずるい！⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{欲|ほ}しい→欲しい：01107_hoshii⟧！
examples.english: No fair! I want some too!

examples.japanese: {狡|ずる}い⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{正々堂々|せいせいどうどう}→正々堂々：25225_seiseidoudou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{戦|たたか}いなさい→戦う：02071_tatakau⟧。
examples.english: Don't play dirty - fight fair and square.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{狡|ずる}い⟦やり{方|かた}→やり方：10532_yarikata⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|かね}→金：02618_kane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{儲|もう}けた→儲ける：20583_moukeru⟧。
examples.english: That person made money through sneaky methods.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧{狡|ずる}い。
examples.english: It's unfair that only you get to take a break.

notes:
{狡|ずる}い describes someone who is sly, cunning, or unfair in their methods.

FORMS:
- {狡|ずる}く (adverbial form)
- {狡|ずる}さ (noun form - slyness)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {狡|ずる}い⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (to use sneaky tactics)
- {狡|ずる}⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to skip school/work with a fake excuse)
- ずるい⟦なあ→なあ：noentry⟧ (that's not fair!)

REGISTER:
Often used by children when complaining about unfairness. In adult contexts, it can describe more serious deceptive behavior.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卑怯|ひきょう}→卑怯：04345_hikyou⟧ (cowardly, unfair - stronger criticism)
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}け{目|め}→抜け目：noentry⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (shrewd, not sly but clever)
- ⟦{狡猾|こうかつ}→狡猾：07639_koukatsu⟧ (cunning, crafty - formal/literary)
